args.title: Fix CSV export merging rows with different currencies
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current CSV export in src/export/csv.ts merges rows that have identical date, amount, and description but different currencies, causing only one row to appear in the exported CSV instead of both. This likely results from the CSV writer not distinguishing rows by currency.

Proposed change: modify the CSV export logic to consider currency as part of the uniqueness criteria when writing rows, ensuring transactions with different currencies but otherwise identical attributes are not merged and both appear separately in the exported CSV output.
